result.title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
result.summary: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. Our analysis reveals a mutually reinforcing mechanism: environmental feedback modeling strengthens hindsight supervision and policy learning, while self-distillation enhances the model's ability to model environmental feedback. With Qwen3-8B, SELF outperforms SDPO and GRPO by 6.4 and 4.1 percentage points in $τ$-bench success rate, and by 10.71 and 3.57 percentage points in AppWorld task goal completion, respectively. These results show that SELF uses environmental feedback more effectively within agentic self-distillation, improving agent capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无奖励交互环境中的语言智能体训练，认为仅让教师模型以环境反馈为条件不足以支撑 hindsight 自蒸馏，提出 SELF 框架，将环境响应预测与反馈条件下的自蒸馏联合优化，并在 τ-bench、AppWorld 上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本智能体工作，不涉及视觉或多模态推理；但「让模型显式预测环境反馈并将其作为辅助监督与蒸馏共同训练」这一线索，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与证据预测的监督设计、贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴。
